# Data Pipeline Problem Definition Note 1

The core problem is that data pipeline handling of staleness interacts with shard; teams noted that materialize depends on compaction and streaming, especially under real production load. Users repeatedly report friction because data pipeline handling of retry interacts with dedupe; teams noted that lineage depends on transform and watermark, especially under real production load. Left unresolved, data pipeline handling of offset interacts with partition; teams noted that orchestrator depends on sink and throughput, especially under real production load, and adoption stalls. The recurring symptom teams flag is that data pipeline handling of latency interacts with checkpoint; teams noted that backfill depends on consumer and schema, especially under real production load.
